outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: lock_to_give_back gives one rule for a stop and a usage refusal (kept while a decision is pending or a dispatch is out). A serial task's pins are asked before start_task (ask_task_pins, in drive_phase and drive_task); apply_answer asks retry's and redispatch's pins before it drops the decision; resume_writer always consumes and judges the member's tree (hand_in_tree; the consume parameter is gone); the review fix reads its brief and writes its prompt before the dispatch mark (review_fix_prompt); validation_dispatch asks both pins before it writes its prompt. A pin is judged on the copy the session loads: a wave member on the session route is asked of the commit its tree will be cut from (skills_at_commit: git ls-tree and cat-file into a scratch directory, hashed by the one reader skill_digest, no second digest; a submodule or a link the reader would refuse is a stop) and of its own tree once it is cut; a serial session and the subagent route's brief are asked of the project; the stop's words name that copy and its remedy (restore and commit, or restore in the tree). The signal line names the member that stopped a wave step; owes_executor's docstring says what the rule is. tests/test_drive_phase.py (spn-block): spd22 derives every stop route from the driver, spd23 is its power, spd24 stops every row's scenarios over a changed skill and compares the whole kept state (drive state, briefs, session files, plan task fields, verbs run, lock claims) before and after, over a table of one stated exception checked both ways; spd25/25a the lock; spd26/26a/27/28 the copy judged and the commit reader; spd16a/16b retry and resume in a tree; spd20a the signal line; spd29 each owes_executor branch with its twin. SECURITY.md, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md and CHANGELOG.md state the same and no more. _skill_places.py is not touched. Whole drive suite through the sweep: 1/1 files ok, 1092 cases; spn-block alone 37/37; mutation probe 47 rows all answered as owed (S/sg2.17/mutations.py).
outcome.descriptive: A step the drive stops over a pin leaves the plan, the drive's files and the phase lock as it found them, and a pin is judged on the copy its session will load.
